features.description: Structured-log emitters emit_chat_turn() + emit_workbench_event() in a new observability/chat_log.py: Cloud Logging entries under log ids aipla_chat_turn / aipla_workbench_event, OTel-GenAI-aligned attribute names, never-raise (log+return on client error).
acceptance_criteria: emit_chat_turn produces a jsonPayload with keys group_id, session_id, skill_id, turn_index, role, content, model, token_in, token_out, latency_ms, teacher_focus under log id aipla_chat_turn
emit_workbench_event produces a jsonPayload with keys group_id, session_id, skill_id, server, tool, field, value under log id aipla_workbench_event
Both helpers never raise when the Cloud Logging client errors (mock raises -> helper returns None, warning logged)
No-PII assertion: emitted payload contains no student name/email/uid key, only group_id
Unit tests cover payload shape, no-PII, and never-raise
features.notes: google-cloud-logging>=3.12.0 already a dep; GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOGGING=1 in prod. Keep emit off the hot path (fire-and-forget).

features.description: Wire the emitters into the agent loop: chat turns from the after-agent callback (make_after_agent_response gains owner_uid + skill_id closures, or a sibling emit callback wired in adk/agent.py, mirroring make_session_tracker); workbench events from POST /api/sessions/{id}/iframe-context. Diff-by-turn cursor in session state so re-runs do not double-emit.
acceptance_criteria: A user+assistant turn triggers exactly one emit_chat_turn per role per turn (no double-emit across the agent loop, verified via an emitted-turn cursor in session state)
An iframe-context write (POST /api/sessions/{id}/iframe-context) triggers one emit_workbench_event with the correct server/tool/field/value
owner_uid and skill_id are threaded into the chat-turn emit via closures (mirroring make_session_tracker), not read from session state
Emit failures never break the chat turn or the iframe-context request
Tests cover both emit sites and the no-double-emit cursor
features.notes: Workbench-state write site confirmed at iframe_context_routes.py (mcp_app_context.{server}.{tool}). after-agent hook is make_after_agent_response() — currently takes no args; mirror make_session_tracker(owner_uid, skill_id) closure wiring in adk/agent.py.

features.description: BigQuery-backed reads behind the unchanged SessionSummary shape. Add google-cloud-bigquery dep; backend/db/bigquery.py thin parameterised region-pinned client; summarize_session_bq() (conversation from chat_turns, message_count, exact sim_run_count from workbench_events, duration); reports route reads BQ first and falls back to live summarize_session on both /sessions/{id} and /groups/{code}.
acceptance_criteria: google-cloud-bigquery added to backend/pyproject.toml and uv.lock; make test-fast still resolves
summarize_session_bq returns a SessionSummary identical in shape to summarize_session (round-trip test with mocked BQ rows)
sim_run_count is an exact COUNT of workbench_events rows (not the mcp_app_context key heuristic)
reports route returns BQ data for ended sessions and falls back to session-state summarize_session when the BQ result is empty (in-flight / sink lag)
/api/reports/sessions/{id} and /api/reports/groups/{code} response shapes are unchanged; no 5xx on empty BQ
jsonPayload numeric fields are CAST to INT64 (matches the terraform views)
features.notes: Dataset chat_logs in aipla-dev-2026 (europe-north1). reports_routes.py endpoints at lines ~37 (get_session_report) and ~49 (get_group_latest_report), both call summarize_session today.

aiplatform logs query --skill <id> --since <date> runs the cohort query and prints/CSV (--format json|csv)
aiplatform logs schema prints the chat_logs dataset location + table schemas (doubles as a smoke check)
logs group registered in the CLI command tree
CLI tests with a mocked client return expected rows/schema
features.notes: Pattern: click.group() + AIPlatformClient from aiplatform.http (see commands/sessions.py).
